name: personal-skills
description: Reusable personal skills for project setup and development workflows.

interface.longDescription: Personal Skills provides reusable local skills for setting up and developing projects across repositories. It includes frontend web project stack selection and scaffolding, Portless web project setup, cross-agent quality hook setup for typecheck/lint/formatting commands, and GitHub repository governance setup for branch rules, security settings, and Dependabot.
defaultPrompt: Use my personal skills for this project setup.
